hikes.name: Rainie Falls
hikes.blurb: Along the river's south bank to a churning drop where rafters line their boats around.

hikes.name: Oregon Caves Big Tree Loop
hikes.blurb: Up from the marble caves through Siskiyou forest to one of Oregon's widest Douglas firs.

hikes.name: Babyfoot Lake
hikes.blurb: Into the Kalmiopsis Wilderness to a small lake ringed by rare Brewer's spruce.

hikes.name: Fish Lake
hikes.blurb: From Mount Elijah/Bigelow Lakes Trailhead, a 10.0-mile round trip to Fish Lake, with about 2,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Kerby Peak
hikes.blurb: From Kerby Peak Trailhead, a 6.3-mile round trip to the top of Kerby Peak (5,536 ft), with about 2,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Summit Lake
hikes.blurb: From Summit Lake Trailhead, a 3.9-mile round trip to Summit Lake, with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Craggy Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Mount Elijah/Bigelow Lakes Trailhead, a 10.5-mile round trip to the top of Craggy Mountain (6,273 ft), with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Stein Butte
hikes.blurb: From New London Trailhead, a 5.8-mile round trip to the top of Stein Butte (4,381 ft), with about 2,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Hinkle Lake
hikes.blurb: From Fir Glade Trailhead, a 3.6-mile round trip to Hinkle Lake, with about 1,000 feet of climbing.
